summary: Backend + mobile-web frontend regression completed on preview. Requested language propagation, native/web picker behavior, Panchangam API/data rendering, correction mode behavior, and viewport checks passed.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning observed: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents

action_items: Remove deprecated pointerEvents prop usage to keep console clean and future-safe.
Align backend env handling with fail-fast policy (avoid fallback defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME).
Update stale Panchangam endpoint comment in backend/server.py that still references old 501-disabled behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Language provider propagation works across Home, Horoscope, Compatibility, Panchangam, Saved Charts, and Account during in-app navigation in both English and Tamil.
Horoscope/Compatibility/Panchangam shared NativeDateTimePicker behavior is stable on web fallback (cancel, reopen, set, confirm) and correctly scopes updates to selected person in compatibility.
backend/server.py still uses default fallbacks for MONGO_URL and DB_NAME, which conflicts with the environment-only/fail-fast guideline.
backend/server.py Panchangam route contains obsolete comments about feature unavailability though endpoint currently returns live data.

success_rate.backend: 100% (27/27 pytest passed including new Panchangam API regression)
success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested functional flows passed; one non-blocking console deprecation warning)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use in-app navigation (screen-header-back-button) for language propagation assertions. Full page reload can reset web language state and is not equivalent to in-app flow continuity.
rca_of_issue: Previously reported Panchangam 501 regression is not reproducible now. Direct API check and pytest confirm /api/panchangam/2026-08-19?language=english returns 200 with real tithi/nakshatra/yoga/karana, rise-set, Rahu/Yama/Gulika, and Abhijit fields.
